title: I Left the Hotel Review With the Exact Thermostat Photo

parts.text: The room was eighty-four degrees at 11:08 p.m. The thermostat was in a locked plastic box. Front desk said the system was set to eco and I should sleep. I was thirty-eight, on a work trip, holding a plastic ice bucket that melted in ten minutes. I photographed the box, the 84, the ice puddle, the eco email. They offered a fan in the morning. I wrote a review with the photos and the sentence: eco is not a lockbox. They replied with a coupon. I used the coupon on a different brand. I slept on the floor near the door crack where a hallway draft lived. Drafts are honest. Lockboxes that withhold air are a genre of review. I publish genres.

social.video_title: Eco came in a lockbox and a puddle of ice — Part 1/1
social.description: 84 degrees, melted bucket, morning fan too late. Would you have demanded a new room at 11 p.m.?
